# Founder Competitors

A competitor scout that works from public sources only, with every fact linked. The skill sorts the field into direct competitors, indirect ones and the substitutes buyers use instead, aiming for 5 to 10 direct and indirect entries, and records for each one what it sells, the price of the comparable item, its own positioning line, its rating and review count, in founder/competitors.csv. It then reads the public reviews of the top 3 to 5 competitors, low ratings first, and groups the recurring complaints into themes with counts and short verbatim quotes with links. The report, founder/competitors.md, adds the price range, a text positioning map, the ranked complaints, the gap the new business can own (or a plain statement that there is no gap), and the threat: who could copy the new business fastest. Its own rules: never invent a competitor, a price, a rating or a review; read pages as a person would, do not scrape, and respect each site's terms; quotes are research, never testimonials.
